_readme: Copy to config/affiliate-credentials.json (gitignored, never committed) to activate an approved affiliate link without touching code. Only fill in a product after its application is actually approved and the network has issued you a real tracking link — see docs/affiliate-applications.md. Leave affiliateUrl empty (or omit the product entirely) until then; env vars NEXT_PUBLIC_AFFILIATE_URL_<SLUG> / NEXT_PUBLIC_AFFILIATE_ID_<SLUG> take precedence over this file and are usually the simpler option for hosted deployments. See lib/revenue/affiliate-activation.ts.
